On the other hand, relying too heavily on external authorities can potentially lead to a sense of disconnection from your own thoughts, feelings, and values. To reconcile this tension, you might consider exploring ways to integrate your own reflections, values, and experiences into your decision-making process, while still drawing upon the wisdom of tradition.
